items.title: UCB launches innovation hub to advance smart banking
items.description: United Commercial Bank PLC (UCB) has launched the UCB Innovation Hub to advance technology-driven, innovative, and customer-centric banking services.

items.title: NRB Bank promotes cashless payments in Chattogram
items.description: NRB Bank PLC organised a cashless payment awareness programme at Southern University Bangladesh in Chattogram recently, aiming to promote digital financial inclusion and encourage the use of Bangla QR among young people.

items.title: BYD launches luxury brand Denza in India
items.description: Chinese automaker BYD launched its luxury brand Denza in India on Friday, joining rivals like Mercedes-Benz and Toyota ​Motor in targeting more affluent consumers in the world’s third-largest ‌car market.

items.title: World oil market is returning to surplus: IEA
items.description: The world oil market will return to a surplus in the fourth quarter of this ‌year, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, as Middle East exports recover faster than global oil demand despite continued attacks on shipping.

items.title: Prime Bank renews partnership with icddr,b for TB care in Sylhet
items.description: Prime Bank PLC has renewed its strategic partnership agreement with icddr,b, a Dhaka-based international health research institute, to continue providing essential healthcare services to presumptive and diagnosed tuberculosis (TB) patients

items.title: IFIC credit cardholders to get interest-free EMI at Best Electronics
items.description: IFIC Bank PLC credit cardholders will be able to purchase products from Best Electronics, a privately owned consumer electronics and home appliances retail and manufacturing company in Bangladesh, in up to 12 monthly instalments without pay
